final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS weather_condition, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT s.weather_condition, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.record_count, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - a.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS a ON a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
